item.title: "Pioneer" An Homage to Morton Subotnick ✨ (Buchla / Keen Association / Morphagene)
item.description: video upload by Stephano Gavilanes "An homage to Morton Subotnick, a living legend and pioneer of electronic music💫 This piece was composed using a Buchla CV/MIDI hybrid setup with the @keenassociationmoscow 220 controller, @mangoestrecords Morphagene, Magnetic Freak - Gaussian, and my own audio samples via MIDI👌🏽 Hope you enjoy it!🤙🏼 Music composed and recorded by Stephano Gavilanes.©

item.title: Recreating String Ensemble sound with Poly Synth
item.description: video upload by George B. "Today I used my OBX8 to recreate the ARP string Ensemble sound. By breaking down how the String Ensemble worked internally, I used what I learned to simulate the ensemble effect. Also I have a three channel ensemble board from an 80's organ that I built into an effects box. So I could compare my settings. Hope you like it! 0:00 Chapter 1 Intro 1:29 Modulation 3:12

item.title: Waldorf Protein. "Small yet crazy", as we say in Polish!
item.description: video upload by Folia Soundstudio "Hellooo, synth lovers! I finally put my hands on Waldorf Protein, a cheap wavetable machine, to discover it potentrial hidden in a small case, with a humble price tag. 'Small, yet crazy' - a Polish saying - fits it very well. Enjoy! 0:00 Intro 2:13 First look 3:06 Some presets 4:45 Wavetables and basic editing 5:47 Envelopes, LFOs 7:10 Effects 8:05
